test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in brackets.

The magician's performance was (captivating) and held the audience spellbound.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Boring**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Captivating"** means something that holds attention or interest; it is enchanting or fascinating. (मोहक/आकर्षक)

 
 
• **Example: **The captivating story kept the readers hooked until the very end.
 
 
 
• **"Boring"** refers to something that is dull, tedious, or uninteresting, which fails to hold attention. (उबाऊ)
 
 
• **Example: **The lecture was so boring that many students struggled to stay awake.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'Captivating'** is **'Boring'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Boring**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fascinating **(दिलचस्प): Extremely interesting or enchanting.

 
 
• **Example:** The fascinating documentary on space exploration captivated the audience.
 
 
 
• **Enchanting **(मनोहर): Delightfully charming or attractive.
 
 
• **Example: **The enchanting garden was filled with vibrant flowers and soothing sounds of nature.
 
 
 
• **Gripping** (रोमांचक): Something that holds your attention completely; thrilling or absorbing.
 
 
• **Example:** The gripping mystery novel kept me reading late into the night.
